title: Made query traces easier to navigate
points: Failure case: the trace viewer exposed the right raw material but stacked audit, router, lane, artifact, table, analyst, and source details together, making ordinary trace review noisy.
Flow logic changed: traces now start with a clickable stage map that separates Overview, Router, Lanes, Artifacts, Tables, Analyst, and Sources.
Shipped result: users can inspect one stage at a time, starting from answer health and moving into deeper SQL, prompt, artifact, or source detail only when needed.
